# InstiSupply

> InstiSupply is a Dubai-based B2B institutional supplies business serving businesses and organisations across the United Arab Emirates.

## Business context

InstiSupply serves institutional and B2B buyers across the UAE, including schools and universities, hospitals and clinics, corporate offices, hotels, restaurants and cafeterias (HORECA), facilities management companies, industrial organisations and worksites, supermarkets, grocery stores and food-service businesses.

Product brands, pack sizes, specifications, availability, pricing and delivery terms are confirmed at quotation stage.

InstiSupply can quote against customer RFQs and existing product lists. Scheduled or call-off supply for recurring requirements can be discussed based on volumes, commercial terms and delivery locations.
